login.title: Channel Ɔhokafo Login
login.welcome: Yɛma wo akwaaba bio! Sign in na hwɛ wo leads no so.
login.heroTitle: Ma wo real-estate adwuma no nyini wɔ lead biara a wode bɛba no mu
login.heroIntro: Portal baako a wode bɛkyerɛw adetɔfoɔ din wɔ adansifoɔ nkyɛn, sie credit ma wo leads na di wɔn akyi kɔ booking.

register.title: Register leads wɔ sikɔne kakraa bi mu
register.text: Fa wo customer ne adwuma a wɔn ani gye ho no kɔma.

protect.title: Ahobammɔ a wɔyɛ no abien
protect.text: Wo lead no tra wo dea mu wɔ ahobammɔ bere no mu, enti obi foforo biara ntumi nnye adetɔfo koro no ara.

track.title: Track stage biara akyi
track.text: Hwɛ lead biara tebea ne n’abakɔsɛm nyinaa, fi bere a wodii kan dii nkitaho kosi bere a wokyerɛwee.

handover.title: Credit bere a wɔrekyerɛw
handover.text: Sɛ adetɔfo bi kyerɛw nhoma a, wɔde nea edi kan no ma ɔdansifo no a woakyerɛw wo din sɛ ɔhokafo a wonya fibea no.

login.secure: Secure sign-in - wo adetɔfoɔ ho nsɛm kɔ so yɛ kokoam
login.builderLink: Kɔ mu wɔ ɔdansifoɔ portal no so

signup.title: Channel Partner a Wɔkyerɛw Wɔn Din
signup.intro: Yɛ wo akontaabu na fi ase kyerɛw wo din na di w’ankasa leads ho dwuma.
